versions.changelog:
Initial release: complete 17-minute autonomous learning/evolution system.

- Implements six core engines: evolution engine, learning extractor, confidence assessment, skill creator, reflection engine, and learning direction generator.
- Supports four main scheduled tasks for autonomous cycles, daily/weekly reflection, and new learning direction generation.
- Provides a self-evolving workflow: autonomous task selection, execution, pattern extraction, confidence evaluation, skill generation, and reflection.
- Includes setup/usage instructions, configuration options, and troubleshooting guidance.
- Designed for personal growth, skill acquisition, and advanced autonomous project management.
